audit_status.source_base: Greek 1 Corinthians text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: Compact complete draft reviewed for gospel tradition, resurrection witnesses, if Messiah not raised, firstfruits, Adam/Messiah, resurrection body, mystery, death swallowed, steadfast labor.

verses.restored: Now I make known to you, siblings, the good news that I announced to you, which you also received, in which you also stand,

familiar.text: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;

verses.restored: through which also you are being saved/healed, if you hold fast the word I announced to you—unless you trusted in vain.

familiar.text: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.

verses.restored: For I handed over to you among first things what I also received: that Messiah died for our sins/misalignments according to the Scriptures,

familiar.text: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;

verses.restored: and that he was buried, and that he has been raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

familiar.text: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:

verses.restored: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the Twelve.

familiar.text: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:

verses.restored: Then he appeared to more than five hundred siblings at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have slept.

familiar.text: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.

verses.restored: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

familiar.text: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.

verses.restored: Last of all, as to one untimely born, he appeared also to me.

familiar.text: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.

verses.restored: For I am the least of the apostles, not fit to be called apostle, because I pursued/persecuted the assembly of the Divine.

familiar.text: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

verses.restored: But by grace of the Divine I am what I am, and his grace toward me did not become empty; rather I labored more abundantly than all of them, yet not I, but the grace of the Divine with me.

familiar.text: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.

verses.restored: Therefore whether I or they, so we proclaim and so you trusted.

familiar.text: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.

verses.restored: Now if Messiah is proclaimed that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say there is no resurrection of dead ones?

familiar.text: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?

verses.restored: But if there is no resurrection of dead ones, neither has Messiah been raised.

familiar.text: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:

verses.restored: And if Messiah has not been raised, then our proclamation is empty, and your trust also empty.

familiar.text: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.

verses.restored: And we are found false witnesses of the Divine, because we witnessed against the Divine that he raised Messiah, whom he did not raise if indeed dead ones are not raised.

familiar.text: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.

verses.restored: For if dead ones are not raised, neither has Messiah been raised.

familiar.text: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:

verses.restored: And if Messiah has not been raised, your trust is futile; you are still in your sins/misalignments.

familiar.text: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.

verses.restored: Then also those who slept in Messiah perished.

familiar.text: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.

verses.restored: If in Messiah we have hoped in this life only, we are more pitiable than all humans.

familiar.text: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.

verses.restored: But now Messiah has been raised from the dead, firstfruit of those who have slept.

familiar.text: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.

verses.restored: For since through a human came death, through a human also came resurrection of dead ones.

familiar.text: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.

verses.restored: For just as in Adam all die, so also in Messiah all will be made alive.

familiar.text: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.

verses.restored: But each in one's own order: Messiah firstfruit, then those of Messiah at his arrival/presence,

familiar.text: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.

verses.restored: then the completion, when he hands over the reign to the Divine and Father, when he makes inactive every ruler and every authority and power.

familiar.text: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.

verses.restored: For it is necessary for him to reign until he places all enemies under his feet.

familiar.text: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

verses.restored: The last enemy being made inactive is death.

familiar.text: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.

verses.restored: For he subjected all things under his feet. But when it says all things have been subjected, it is clear that the One who subjected all things to him is excepted.

familiar.text: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.

verses.restored: When all things are subjected to him, then the Son himself also will be subjected to the One who subjected all things to him, so that the Divine may be all in all.

familiar.text: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.

verses.restored: Otherwise, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If dead ones are not raised at all, why are they baptized for them?

familiar.text: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?

verses.restored: Why also are we in danger every hour?

familiar.text: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?

verses.restored: I die daily, by the boasting in you, siblings, which I have in Messiah Jesus our Lord.

familiar.text: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our LORD, I die daily.

verses.restored: If according to human reasoning I fought beasts in Ephesus, what is the profit to me? If dead ones are not raised, Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.

familiar.text: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.

verses.restored: Do not be deceived: Harmful companionships corrupt useful/good character.

familiar.text: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.

verses.restored: Sober up righteously/justly and do not sin/misalign; for some have ignorance of the Divine. I speak this toward your shame.

familiar.text: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.

verses.restored: But someone will say, How are dead ones raised? With what sort of body do they come?

familiar.text: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?

verses.restored: Foolish one, what you sow is not made alive unless it dies.

familiar.text: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:

verses.restored: And what you sow, you do not sow the body that will come to be, but a bare grain, perhaps of wheat or of some other.

familiar.text: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain:

verses.restored: But the Divine gives it a body just as he willed, and to each of the seeds its own body.

familiar.text: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.

verses.restored: Not all flesh is the same flesh, but one of humans, another flesh of animals, another flesh of birds, another of fish.

familiar.text: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.

verses.restored: And there are heavenly bodies and earthly bodies; but different is the glory of the heavenly, and different of the earthly.

familiar.text: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.

verses.restored: One glory of sun, another glory of moon, another glory of stars; for star differs from star in glory.

familiar.text: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.

verses.restored: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in decay, it is raised in incorruptibility.

familiar.text: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:

verses.restored: It is sown in dishonor, it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness, it is raised in power.

familiar.text: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:

verses.restored: It is sown a natural/soul-level body, it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural/soul-level body, there is also a spiritual body.

familiar.text: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.

verses.restored: So also it is written: The first human, Adam, became a living soul; the last Adam became life-making Spirit.

familiar.text: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.

verses.restored: But the spiritual is not first, but the natural/soul-level; afterward the spiritual.

familiar.text: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.

verses.restored: The first human is from earth, made of dust; the second human is from heaven.

familiar.text: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.

verses.restored: As the one made of dust, so also those made of dust; and as the heavenly one, so also the heavenly ones.

familiar.text: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.

verses.restored: And just as we bore the image of the one made of dust, we will also bear the image of the heavenly one.

familiar.text: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.

verses.restored: This I say, siblings, that flesh and blood are not able to inherit the reign of the Divine, nor does decay inherit incorruptibility.

familiar.text: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.

verses.restored: Look, I tell you a mystery: we will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,

familiar.text: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,

verses.restored: in an instant, in a blink of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.

familiar.text: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.

verses.restored: For this decaying one must put on incorruptibility, and this dying one put on deathlessness.

familiar.text: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.

verses.restored: When this decaying one puts on incorruptibility and this dying one puts on deathlessness, then the word written will come to be: Death was swallowed into victory.

familiar.text: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.

verses.restored: Where, O death, is your victory? Where, O death, is your sting?

familiar.text: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?

verses.restored: The sting of death is sin/misalignment, and the power of sin/misalignment is the Law.

familiar.text: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.

verses.restored: But thanks to the Divine, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Messiah.

familiar.text: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.restored: Therefore, my beloved siblings, become steadfast, immovable, abounding in the work of the Lord always, knowing that your labor is not empty in the Lord.

familiar.text: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.

translation_notes: Spiritual body does not mean non-body; it is body animated/transformed by Spirit. Paul is anti-decay, not anti-body.
Firstfruits and resurrection language should preserve embodied/cosmic hope rather than escape from creation.
